reviews.author: Griffen Angel
reviews.text: I came down to Hartsville to buy a car, and I decided to take it by Brad's for a pre-purchase inspection. I didn't have to wait long before he went through the major bits, giving me a thorough rundown of the condition of the car, noting how much it would be to repair any deficiencies. He also had insight into the workings of the local dealerships in the area, which was useful in learning more about who I would be buying from. I'm located pretty far away from Hartsville, but if I was local, I'd take my car to Brad's for all it's service needs, without question. A+ work.

reviews.author: Ryan Quaal
reviews.text: I was in town at a dealership looking at a used car. I called Brads and asked if I could bring the vehicle that I was looking to purchase in for him to look at and give a once over to make sure everything was good on the vehicle. He told me to bring it on in. He spent at least a half hour of his time both at his shop and on the phone. Absolutely fantastic service. I was very grateful for his insight with the used vehicle. I live out of town, but if was ever in the Hartsville area again I wouldn't think twice. I'd go to Brads.

reviews.author: Robert Grove
reviews.text: My daughter goes to college in this town and I’m not close enough by to help. Brad was very quick to get our situation taken care of and we will use him again. Highly recommended….. thank you, Brad and your entire team!

reviews.author: Sarah Kristi
reviews.text: The men here are very kind, honest and knowledgeable. You really can’t put a price on driving away and feeling safe.

reviews.author: Ron Acord
reviews.text: I have dealt with several garages in Hartsville and the Pee Dee area. There is no comparison, Brad's is the only one that I have felt like I got a fair deal. Their work is second to none and their prices can't be beat. When they give you an estimate and tell you when your automobile will be ready it is spot on. I have never gotten a "surprise" charge like I have at other shops. I have always received fast and friendly service. These guys go above and beyond anything I expected. I don't think there is anything they cannot do. They are truly full service engine work, interior, tires exhaust, computer tuning, installing aftermarket parts even exotic things like Superchargers, they can do it. As far as I'm concerned the other shops in the area may as well close their doors. Before I checked with Brad's I had my Mach 1 at a couple other shops for a VERY long time for a restoration with nothing but bad results. This is what she looked like after a few days at Brad's. I couldn't be more pleased.The Mach 1 is a trophy winner now.

reviews.author: Whitney matthews
reviews.text: I was greeted very nicely. And after asking for some advice. The owner Brad happily tested my car diagnosed it and I was able to repair it myself. He knows what he is doing. Great experience 10/10 recommend if you like easy going atmosphere. Hard workers. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Noelle Handley
reviews.text: Car was over heating and I needed it looked at asap. I was told they would look at it as soon as I could get there. Got there and they looked at it, told me what was going on and had me back on the road in 30 mins or less. I will definitely start taking my cars to Brad's when they decide to break. Thank you!!!!

reviews.author: Brian Anderson
reviews.text: These guys came through for my daughter. My daughter attends GSSM, and we are from Charleston. She has an old BMW which needed a new battery. Worse yet, the battery was in the trunk, and the trunk was battery-operated... I called Brad, and they came out the same day, figured out how to get it started, picked up my daughter's car, brought it back to their shop, ordered the special battery, changed it and had it back to her in less than 4 hours then charged a reasonable rate. She could drive home for Christmas break, and I don't have to tow her car back to Charleston. Thanks, Brad and co. - Amazing service, I am very grateful,l and I will not forget it!

reviews.author: Sheri Giles
reviews.text: Stopped in because my low tire pressure light came on. Brad made sure I was good to go in under 10 minutes. Many thanks for your service!

reviews.author: Amanda-lee Vitti
reviews.text: I took my outback there to have an electrical diagnostics run on it and I was seen fairly quickly. Brad had his employee run the diagnostics on it, they found the code and reset it, and I was never charged. I can't tell you how impressed I am today with the service I received here and if I have anymore issues in the meantime with my vehicle while I am working here in Hartsville I will definitely be taking it back here. It's not all too often that as a female I find a reputable and honest local mechanic who I don't feel like is trying to take advantage of me simply because I am a woman but today Brad proved otherwise. He showed me nothing but respect, which put me at ease, and made me feel like I was a valued customer walking into his shop. Truly, I'm grateful for this experience as it shows me that there are genuinely honest and fair autoshop owners out there who actually care about their customers regardless of whether you are a male or a female. I would highly recommend going there for any vehicle issues that might need fixing as Brad will definitely make sure that you are taken care of in a professional and fair manner. Thanks again, Brad! Your good deed did not go unnoticed today!!

reviews.author: Amanda Sturkie
reviews.text: Brad was so nice to work with. He helped my daughter get her window up when the motor broke and saved us a lot of time and money! Highly recommend him. Such a nice guy!

reviews.author: Lee Rains
reviews.text: If I could give this place a negative rating I would. I never had problems with my car until I brought it to Brads Automotive. I had them do a simple realignment and oil change. Next thing I know my AC goes out so I take it to them and they charge me 400 bucks to fix it. They said they saved me money and it was just the belt that came off. they told me to drop it off Friday and they would have it for me by the end of the day and they kept my car for a week and I found out by a neighbor that they saw them hot rodding my car around town. My AC goes out again not even a month later so I take it to my trusted mechanic in fort mill and he says the belt slipped off because they put a belt over the existing belt and they only charged me 120 to fix it. Now my trusted mechanic tells me my transmission is about ready to go out. Brads Automotive was so unprofessional it’s ridiculous. The main mechanic has meth mouth so bad his teeth are rotting out of his head and looks like he has not showered in a month. If I would have known he was the one working on my car I would have went elsewhere. The owner is oblivious and is never there and does not touch the cars or have them ready when he says he will. Do not take your vehicles here you will regret it like I do.

reviews.author: Arnie Bixler
reviews.text: Mr. Brad was very courteous and honest with me. He checked over my car the same day that it arrived. I wasn't able to afford to repair the car, but Mr. Brad was very helpful with giving me some advice. I will definitely be back if I have more car trouble. GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE!!

reviews.author: Bryson S. Caldwell
reviews.text: Brad and the entire staff were beyond professional and very prompt. Brad gave me a time frame and the services performed were complete well within. I would highly recommend this auto repair shop for all of your car repair needs. Brad has the equipment, staff, and resources available to complete any task you present. Honesty and integrity go a long way when it comes to vital transportation maintenance. This is an establish all can trust!

reviews.author: Shateesha Haynes
reviews.text: Kenie, one of the mechanics, was very helpful and explained what he had to do in great detail so that I knew what was going on. And he was nice enough to get my car back to me asap, because I needed it before they closed. They have a new customer for life. I already recommended my daughter to them.

reviews.author: Olivia
reviews.text: In two minutes flat Brad took care of an issue that Fireside told me would cost $400. Honest mechanic! Thank you.

reviews.author: Jenna Harrington
reviews.text: Highly recommend Brad's! I showed up without an appointment to look at my Jeep radio. He fixed it on the spot and even showed me how to fix it myself if it ever happens again! Great service.

reviews.author: Maggie Jacob
reviews.text: Brad’s shop was friendly on the phone and let me bring in my vehicle immediately over a popped tire. They had me in and out in under 30 min. Great friendly and local place! Would definitely go back if needed.

reviews.author: Brittany James
reviews.text: Brad and his crew were quick to help with with my Tahoe! Very professional and went out of their way to fix what I needed! Another amazing visit! Will us them for all of my automotive needs!

reviews.author: Eric Brown
reviews.text: I pulled up to Brad's because I had a question about some error lights that came on my truck and he stopped what he was doing to help me. On top of that He diagnosed what the problem was, looked up the part number I needed for me and told me where to go and get it in all of 5 minutes. This man knows what he is doing 10/10 would recommend him to anyone in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Sharon Mills
reviews.text: We were headed to the beach from NC, lights on my dash lite up. We thought it was the alternator and someone at McLeod Farms recommended his shop. We were 1 minute away and my car completely died. We walked down to his shop, he was super friendly and wanted to help. He provided us with towing company information as well as car rental. After his diagnostic test, he found it was a belt and not the alternator. Within no time, we were back on the road. Highly recommend his shop. Thank you Brad and staff!!!!

reviews.author: Michele Crenshaw
reviews.text: Kenny is helpful and does excellent work in a timely manner. We are totally satisfied and will be back!!

reviews.author: Chase Atkinson
reviews.text: Brad is an awesome guy and mechanic. Stopped everything to help me fix my truck after an ongoing limp mode issue that even Chevrolet couldn’t fix. He helped me narrow down every issue until we fixed it. Can’t speak highly enough of him and his work. Don’t get mad Get BRAD!

reviews.author: mike P
reviews.text: Brad is always been very helpful and reasonable with anything I’ve needed. This business is trustworthy and I would recommend him for your car repairs.

reviews.author: Edwin Torres
reviews.text: Had coolant leaking from my water pump and my car was on the verge of overheating! Dropped my car off and one of the mechanics, Kenny, called me the next day to tell me step by step what was wrong, how much it would cost, and what he could do to fix my problem ASAP. They were even kind enough to stay after closing hours for me to pick up my car after work so I wouldn't have to wait until Monday. I came for a solution, and I left with a place I can recommend to anyone having car trouble!

reviews.author: Mallori Gainey
reviews.text: Brads auto is amazing! Staff is very friendly and very professional. The owner got me a great deal on some tires and replaced a few other parts in a timely manner. Also couldn’t have got it cheaper anywhere else. Definitely recommend this shop.

reviews.author: Allison Jennings
reviews.text: Made an appointment on 7/6 for 7/8. Drove all the way to the shop, sign posted closed from 7/6-7/11, shop made no attempt to reach out to it's customers to let them know they would be closed. Had 3 trucking days to do so for mines. Lucky I had made other appointments and didn't cancel them. Met an older couple who had previously had a/c work done there and, they had drove over 50 miles for their appointment to get the work redone under warranty. They weren't given notice either, said all the shop did was replace a fuse and it blew when he open the car door one day. It's super hot outside do be driving around w/o a/c. Next time take the 1 star

reviews.author: William M Stubbs
reviews.text: Had an awesome experience with Brad and his team. My Jeep had an issue that was hard to find but Brad and his team kept on until problem solved!!!

reviews.author: Tip Of the Day
reviews.text: Great service! Very transparent in keeping me abreast of the work that my van needed showing me exactly where the issues were. They were friendly and able to do the jobs all in a very timely manner, right before my family and I had to travel for the holidays.

reviews.author: chelsa sellers
reviews.text: I highly recommend Brads Automotive!! I can into the shop and they ran a car diagnostic test for me for free just out of the kindness of their hearts!! I will definitely be returning to them with any of my car needs!

reviews.author: Daryl Ellerby
reviews.text: I was able to stop in and get my tires serviced fast. Very professional owner and staff! Fair pricing and hometown manners. (they actually look you in the eye when talking to you) I highly recommend this business for your repair needs.

reviews.author: James Temoney
reviews.text: Man I have brad work on my 2019 Ram 1500. Stand up guy and always walks you through everything. That's my Mechanic forever

reviews.author: Jackie Kranzler
reviews.text: Please don't take your car here I am really not happy. My car was with this shop for over 7 week to have the altanator replaced with a new one I had purchased. When I got the bill I was charged for an altanator and my car had ben rummaged through even the change in my ash tray was gone.

reviews.author: Taylor Davis
reviews.text: Walked right in and asked for help with my tire. The service tech immediately went out and looked at my tire, found the screw and plugged the tire. Very seamless process and extremely courteous staff

reviews.author: Aundra Mack
reviews.text: Just called try to get information on a quote. The guy answered the phone heard my voice and I told him what kind a truck I want to get fixed and he hang up the phone They have a disrespectful place. I would won’t and I want to deal with that kind of attitude or demeanor I thought them days was over with.

reviews.author: Isaac Rowe
reviews.text: Brad put a muffler on my car for me this morning (7-24-19) and did a fantastic job. He was very friendly and charged a good rate too.

reviews.author: Samantha Griggs
reviews.text: Great place! Brad & his staff are super friendly and helpful! His location is convenient and he’s always honest. I would definitely recommend to anyone without a bit of hesitation!

reviews.author: Brandy Russell
reviews.text: Very much recommend, Bradly was on time when scheduled and also got the job done. He is very respectful and patient. Also teaches you and answers any questions you have about the issue while performing.

reviews.author: tina gaskins
reviews.text: I had my alternator put in and my oil changed and they did an awesome job. They did great work, truly appreciate their hard work. Recommend them highly.... Thanks Brad!!!

reviews.author: Wes Green
reviews.text: My wife took my Jeep in to have a tire fixed. Tire still leaks and they lost my custom valve cap. Promised several times that he would replace it. Now says to stop at the shop to get cash so I can order a replacement....???? You lost it you order it!

reviews.author: Regina Ard
reviews.text: Brad is always super friendly and knowledgeable. He lets you know up front what’s going on. No hidden fees and charges. Doesn’t try to berate you if you’re a female. Fast service. This guy knows what he’s doing!

reviews.author: Kennn
reviews.text: Brad is rude, & unprofessional. My Car sat at his shop for 2 weeks before he even told me what was wrong with it, then he didn’t know what was wrong so he kept giving me the run around. He told me everyday it would be ready the next day & it wasn’t. It sat in the field & mice ate the wires up inside. I ended up taking my car from his shop to Ward’s & Ward’s fixed it in 2 days.

reviews.author: Roxanne Kidd
reviews.text: Brad looked over my suv and knew the issue right away. Fixed it in a timely manner. Very helpful. Very knowledgeable. Appreciate everything he did for me getting my suv right.

reviews.author: Ms Kyna
reviews.text: Excellent service and friendly people. They gave me a time to be there, they began working on my car immediately. I highly recommend this garage service.

reviews.author: Jason Wooton
reviews.text: Gave me a diagnostics quick and easy with no bs. Dealership was going to charge me my left kidney. Fortunately he saved my hide on this one, young and smart fellow here. If you want someone that shoots straight and won't waste your time, go here.

reviews.author: bailey
reviews.text: They were super helpful! Helped me get my window rolled up because it was stuck, didn’t take long at all and everyone was very nice, if i ever have car troubles again i would come here

reviews.author: Lashunda Tyson
reviews.text: I recently moved to sc and was looking for a shop to fix my car found brads automotive repair 1 st service he change my front brakes 2nd time he fix my oil leak with no issue or problem .. the staff are very friendly and kind I enjoy having conversations with them while the car getting worked on… I would recommend anyone that need there car look at or anything about a car to give me a visit or call cause now he will be the only one working on my car

reviews.author: Sarah Carmen
reviews.text: Brad was very professional and helpful explaining my vehicles issue. He resolved the problem for me the same day! Will definitely return

reviews.author: Justin R
reviews.text: Highly recommend Brad's Automotive 100%. Very knowledgeable staff that do great work for reasonable price. I'll definitely be going back!

reviews.author: Jessie Ghoens
reviews.text: Great service and prices, the best in Hartsville in my opinion. When ever I have an issue or just looking to make some upgrades to my truck Brad is always willing to help no matter what.

reviews.author: JD Diven
reviews.text: I went to Strickland brothers to get my oil changed and had no oil pressure after the oil changed I then went to Brad's Automotive to get a diag we figured out the problem and quickly and and he even gave me a ride to my house I can see why he is ranked highly with the etter business bouro 10 out of 10 highly recommend his shop just a nice gentleman!

reviews.author: Marsha
reviews.text: Had car trouble and was lucky enough to make it here. Brad knew right off what the problem was and was able to have it fixed in a timely manner. Great place.

reviews.author: Kathleen Bullard
reviews.text: Excellent, excellent, excellent. Not only did the hook me up in one day, but they stayed after hours till the job was done and it was only 100 degrees outside. They get all my business from now on. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Travis Kelley
reviews.text: Brad and his guys do a great job. They are honest and very resonably priced. Tires, chasis/suspension and exhaust, these guys can handle it all!!

reviews.author: Bethany Cable
reviews.text: Great service and friendly owner and staff . Was ready when promised and the price was very reasonable.We will return for any auto repair needs highly recommend.

reviews.author: Russell Young
reviews.text: Hit a pothole and messed up front suspension...Mr Blake took the time out of his day to make sure my insurance claim was done correct with no Hassel thank you so much to everyone at brads automotive they were friendly almost felt like family

reviews.author: David A.
reviews.text: Brad does pretty good work. His prices are reasonable compared to other shops. Use him slot for minor repairs when needed.

reviews.author: Breanna Byrd
reviews.text: My daddy brought his vehicle to this shop and they had fixed it quick! Family friendly and very welcoming!

reviews.author: Lisa Soltero
reviews.text: A local home town auto repair shop own and operated by a very friendly and courteous Mechanic .. who has staff that too care about their customers and perform quality work on a timely manner.

reviews.author: Caroline Perry
reviews.text: Very fair and reasonable! Serviced and fixed the ac in my daughter’s car and it didn’t break the bank!

reviews.author: Cesar Delapaz
reviews.text: came in from out of town, my 06 crossfire coolant light came on, took to Brad's he topped me off and gave it a once over recommendation to get it look at later... thanks

reviews.author: Melody Walters
reviews.text: He did everything he promised he would and on time . Friendly and professional. My mama says she will take her vehicle to him only.

reviews.author: Marianne Borey
reviews.text: The service was spot on. Answered all my questions with efficient answers and made it easy to understand!! Manager and staff worked hard and got the job done!!

reviews.author: Kind Heart
reviews.text: This shop is very professional. The workers are very kind and fast working . I recommend them to anyone in town .
